label: fused-off-large-uring
command:
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'tests')
import aoffix2 as h
h.ARGS=SimpleNamespace(binary=Path('build/tomokv').resolve(),cores='112-119',port=25006,mode='1s',engine=sys.argv[1],ratio='6:2',oracle=False,artifacts=Path(sys.argv[2]))
h.ARGS.artifacts.mkdir(parents=True)
with h.Server(h.aof('off'),single=True) as s:
 c=s.client();v=b'x'*(5*1024*1024)
 assert c.cmd('SET','big',v)==b'OK'
 assert c.cmd('GET','big')==v
 assert c.cmd('PING')==b'PONG'
 h.emit('aof_off_large_control',size=len(v),passed=True)
